parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The two methods — `recordRequestSentIncrementsCount` (line 38) and `recordSongAddedToLibraryIncrementsCount` (line 54) — are distinct test cases that verify separate behaviors of `ReviewRequestService` (recording a review request vs. recording a song addition). Although their structural shape is similar (Jaccard 0.75), each test exercises a different code path and must remain independently named and independently runnable. Merging or abstracting them would obscure test intent and violate the principle that each test should have a single, clearly named reason to fail.
